fee_notes: Royalties are NOT based on franchisee gross sales; instead they are collected from vendors as part of product cost. Royalty amounts range from $0.10 to $75 per option/unit, or up to 12% of the franchisee's cost of the product purchased from the vendor. No percentage-of-gross-sales royalty applies. Local/regional cooperative fees currently not collected; if established, capped at 3% of gross sales. Minimum Local Advertising Amount is the greater of the amount needed to meet Minimum MSI or 7% of prior calendar year gross sales. Technology Fee is currently $499/month (base); increases to $549/month effective January 1, 2027; optional web design/management services add $176/month; optional Premium Services add $299/month with $0.01/message overage above 7,500 messages/month; $600 start-up fee for existing franchisees (not new). Tech fee not charged until 7th month of operations for new franchisees. Base Technology Fee subject to 20% cap over any rolling 36-month period.
